instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to light in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>to light</lang> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: During Hann-ookkah, we light one candle on the menorah every night.
atoms.b: During Hanukkah, we ((light)) one candle on the menorah every night.

atoms.sound: Last night my sister and I lit the candle together.
atoms.b: Last night, my sister and I ((lit)) the candle together.

atoms.sound: Now we have lit all nine candles.
atoms.b: Now we have ((lit)) all nine candles.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to sweep in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>to sweep</lang> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: Ali sweeps the floor of his café every morning.
atoms.b: Ali ((sweeps)) the floor of his café every morning.

atoms.sound: Yesterday, he swept it in the afternoon as well.
atoms.b: Yesterday, he ((swept)) it in the afternoon as well.

atoms.sound: He has never swept the floor at night.
atoms.b: He has never ((swept)) the floor at night.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to forecast in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>to forecast</lang> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: The news anchor forecasts sunshine for tomorrow.
atoms.b: The news anchor ((forecasts)) sunshine for tomorrow.

atoms.sound: She forecast the same yesterday too.
She has forecast nice weather a lot recently.
atoms.b: She has ((forecast)) nice weather a lot recently.
